'''Gree Baaker''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Gree Baaker system/Legends|Gree Baaker system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]]. Under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], it was home to the [[Gree Baaker Labor Camp]]. Many of the camp's [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] were transferred to work detail on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], and later [[Death/Legends|perished]] with its [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].

==Description==
Gree Baaker was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Gree Baaker system/Legends|system of the same name]]. It was part of the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="TEAOC" /> which also fell in the region known as the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]].<ref name="Region" />

==History==
During the administration of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the planet was home to the [[Gree Baaker Labor Camp]]. Various [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] were sentenced to life imprisonment on the planet, such as [[Ilaani Soresh]] and her son [[Kimali Soresh|Kimali]]. Kimali had come under the influence of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] shortly after graduating from the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]], and his mother tried to help him escape and create a new identity. However, when she revealed this to her husband, [[Rezi Soresh]], an Imperial officer, he turned both his wife and his son into the authorities, receiving a promotion for his loyalty to the Empire.<ref name="RFT" />

The prisoners from Gree Baaker were later assigned to work duty<ref name="RFT" /> on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]]&mdash;more commonly known as the Death Star<ref name="Rebellion Era Campaign Guide">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>&mdash;which was being constructed in the [[Horuz system/Legends|Horuz system]] of the Atrivis [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> With the Death Star's destruction at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], all of the Gree Baaker prisoners assigned there perished. Rezi Soresh was informed of their [[Death/Legends|deaths]] in the presence of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] shortly after its destruction.<ref name="RFT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gree Baaker was created by [[Alex Wheeler]] for the [[2008]] young-adult novel ''[[Rebel Force: Target]]'', the first installment in the ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Force]]'' series.<ref name="RFT" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the planet in grid square L-5.<ref name="TEAOC" />
